EMPTY.TITLE: No pipelines yet
EMPTY.ADMIN: Create the first pipeline to organize your sales in stages.
EMPTY.AGENT: An administrator needs to create the first pipeline.

LEAD_ENTRY_HINT.TOOLTIP: Every new conversation becomes a deal in the default pipeline

LEAD_ENTRY.TOGGLE: Create a deal for each new conversation
LEAD_ENTRY.DESCRIPTION: When a conversation that matches the rules below is assigned to an agent, it becomes an open deal in the default pipeline, in the first stage, and the agent becomes the owner. This setting applies to the whole account. Turning it off keeps the deals already on the board.
LEAD_ENTRY.NEEDS_DEFAULT: Create a pipeline first: it becomes the default.
LEAD_ENTRY.LISTS_HINT: Uncheck what should not become a lead. With everything checked in a list, channels and origins added later are included too. With more than one list unchecked, the conversation must match all of them.

ALERT_DAYS.LABEL: Warn when waiting more than (days)
ALERT_DAYS.HINT: After this period, the lead gets an alert badge on the column and on the board header.

CARD.HINT: Choose up to {max} fields to show under the standard card. The whole team sees the same fields on every card of this pipeline.

AI.TITLE: Pipeline AI
AI.DESCRIPTION: Uses the ChatClean AI key. You choose what it does on the deal cards and how much it may spend per month.

NEXT_STEP.TITLE: Suggest the next step
NEXT_STEP.HINT: Shows on the card what to do next with the customer.

FILL_ON_MOVE.TITLE: Fill fields when moving
FILL_ON_MOVE.HINT: When a deal changes stage, fills the required fields from the conversation.

TEMPERATURE.TITLE: Explain the temperature badge
TEMPERATURE.HINT: Shows how hot the deal is and why.

MONTHLY_CAP.LABEL: Monthly spending cap (R$)
MONTHLY_CAP.HINT: Set a value above zero to turn on any of the three.

AI.CAP_REACHED: The cap was reached: the AI stops until next month.

TYPE.LABEL: Type
TYPE.LOCKED: The type was set on creation and does not change

ITEM_LABEL.LABEL: What to call each item
ITEM_LABEL.HINT: Shows on the "New…" button, on counters, on the card and on menus. You can change it later: it is only the text.

STALE_DAYS.LABEL: Deal stalled after (days)
STALE_DAYS.HINT: Every new stage starts with this limit. Won and lost do not count.
STALE_DAYS.INVALID: Use a whole number between 1 and {max}

ONE_CARD.LABEL: One card per contact
ONE_CARD.HINT: If the contact already has an open card in this pipeline, that card opens instead of creating another. Only this pipeline counts.

STAGES.LABEL: Stages
STAGES.HINT: Drag to change the order. New contact always comes first.

FORM.CLOSING_STAGES_HINT: The pipeline starts with the New contact stage. The won and lost columns are required and always close the board.

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete pipeline
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the pipeline {name}? Its stages are deleted too.

API.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load the pipelines. Try again.
API.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the pipeline. Try again.

STALE_DAYS.LABEL: Stalled after (days)
STALE_DAYS.HINT: The card turns yellow close to this limit and red after it.

OWNER.LABEL: Require owner
OWNER.HINT: The deal only enters this stage with an owner

CUSTOM_FIELDS.LABEL: Require filled fields
CUSTOM_FIELDS.EMPTY: No deal field yet. Create them in Settings → Custom attributes → Deal.

TASKS.LABEL: Required tasks
TASKS.HINT: The deal gets these tasks when it enters the stage.

LABELS.LABEL: Apply labels
LABELS.EMPTY: No labels in the account yet.

DOCUMENT.LABEL: Require document
DOCUMENT.HINT: The deal only enters this stage with an attached document

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete stage
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the stage {name}?

IMPULSES.TITLE: Impulses: {stage}
IMPULSES.DESCRIPTION: Automatic messages sent to the contact when a deal enters this stage.
IMPULSES.EMPTY: This stage has no impulses yet.
IMPULSES.ENTRY_HINT: Impulses start when a deal enters the stage. Deals already in it are not affected. Leaving the stage cancels the pending steps.

ERRORS.NAME: Use up to {max} characters.
ERRORS.DELAY: Enter a whole wait of 0 or more.
ERRORS.DELAY_MAX: The wait can be at most 90 days.

CAMPAIGNS.DESCRIPTION: Send one message now to the deals that are in this stage. Deals that enter later do not receive it.
CAMPAIGNS.EMPTY: No campaign has been sent from this stage yet.

FILTERS.TITLE: Who receives it
FILTERS.STALE_DAYS: In the stage for more than (days)
FILTERS.STALE_HINT: Leave it empty to include every deal in the stage.

PREVIEW.SUMMARY: This campaign will be queued for {count} deal currently in this stage. | This campaign will be queued for {count} deals currently in this stage.
PREVIEW.WITHOUT_CONTACT: {count} deal without a contact will be skipped. | {count} deals without a contact will be skipped.
PREVIEW.IN_RUNNING_CAMPAIGN: {count} deal is already in a running campaign of this stage and will be skipped. | {count} deals are already in a running campaign of this stage and will be skipped.
PREVIEW.NONE: There are no eligible deals with a contact in this stage.
PREVIEW.CLOSED_HINT: Closed deals count only when closed in the last 30 days, as on the board.
PREVIEW.INTERVAL: Messages go out one every 3 seconds.

SALES.TITLE: Sales & Pipeline
SALES.DESCRIPTION: Pipeline, revenue, losses and the team's pace

CONVERSION.LABEL: Conversion
CONVERSION.EMPTY: no deal won or lost in the period

TICKET.LABEL: Average ticket
TICKET.EMPTY: no deal won in the period

CLOSE_TIME.LABEL: Time to close
CLOSE_TIME.EMPTY: no deal won in the period

PIPELINE.TITLE: Pipeline
PIPELINE.TOOLTIP: {count} deals · {value} · {total}% of total · {top}% of the top
PIPELINE.NO_PIPELINE: Create a pipeline to see its stages.

CONVERSION.TITLE: Conversion between stages
CONVERSION.DESCRIPTION: Deals created in the period: how many reached each stage and how many moved on to the next. A skipped stage does not count. A stage may have more deals than the previous one.

COLLABORATORS.TITLE: Team members
COLLABORATORS.DESCRIPTION: Won against lost, and each one's activities

STAGNATION.TITLE: Stagnation per stage
STAGNATION.DESCRIPTION: How many open deals passed the stage's limit

BY_ORIGIN.DESCRIPTION: Leads from each origin and how many of the closed ones became a sale

BY_CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION: Leads from each entry channel and how many of the closed ones became a sale

ORIGIN_WINS.DESCRIPTION: Each origin's share of the value won

BY_COMPANY.DESCRIPTION: The accounts that brought the most in the period, and what is still at stake with each one
BY_COMPANY.EMPTY: No company with deals in the period.

WON_REASONS.EMPTY: No deal won with a reason in the period.

LOST_REASONS.DESCRIPTION: How many deals each reason took
LOST_REASONS.EMPTY: No deal lost in the period.

WON_DEALS.DESCRIPTION: Each sale of the period, with what was sold and how long it took
WON_DEALS.EMPTY: No deal won in the period.

LOST_DEALS.DESCRIPTION: Reason and note of each loss
LOST_DEALS.EMPTY: No deal lost in the period.

LOST_BY_ASSIGNEE.DESCRIPTION: Who loses the most, in proportion to what they closed
LOST_BY_ASSIGNEE.EMPTY: No deal lost in the period.

WHERE_LOST.DESCRIPTION: In which stage of the pipeline the sale died, and how much that weighs
WHERE_LOST.EMPTY: No deal lost in the period.

OVERVIEW.TITLE: Overview

WON.LABEL: Sales won
WON.HINT: {count} deal in the period | {count} deals in the period

CONVERSION.LABEL: Conversion
CONVERSION.EMPTY: no deal created in the period

BEST_DAY.LABEL: Best day
BEST_DAY.HINT: peak of {count} conversation | peak of {count} conversations

BY_CHANNEL.TITLE: By channel
BY_CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION: Conversations of the period per entry channel

AGENTS.TITLE: Performance by agent
AGENTS.EMPTY: No agent with conversations or sales in the period.

OVERVIEW.UNREAD_HINT: Only conversations with customer messages no one on the team has opened yet.
